title: The Hot Shot Rule for Better Leadership

cues.text: So when I think about confidence, I first ground myself in the definition.
cues.en: So when I think about confidence, I first ground myself in the definition.
cues.zh: 當我在思考「信心」時， 我會先從定義來瞭解基礎。

cues.text: Confidence is just the reliance
cues.en: Confidence is just the reliance
cues.zh: 信心是對他人能力 或特質的信賴或確信。

cues.text: or assurance that we believe in someone's abilities or qualities.
cues.en: or assurance that we believe in someone's abilities or qualities.

cues.text: It's simply through actions.
cues.en: It's simply through actions.
cues.zh: 就是透過行動。

cues.text: So the best way to drive and build confidence,
cues.en: So the best way to drive and build confidence,

cues.text: is to drive action.
cues.en: is to drive action.

cues.text: Interestingly, many people think you need a lot of confidence
cues.en: Interestingly, many people think you need a lot of confidence
cues.zh: 有趣的是，許多人認為需要先有 很大的信心才能採取大膽的行動。

cues.text: to take bold action.
cues.en: to take bold action.
cues.zh: 我的看法恰恰相反。

cues.text: I think the opposite is true.
cues.en: I think the opposite is true.
cues.zh: 我的看法恰恰相反。

cues.text: It’s action. Just getting comfortable with it over time.
cues.en: It’s action. Just getting comfortable with it over time.
cues.zh: 重點是行動。隨著時間， 我們會對行動越來越自在，

cues.text: Doing more and better regularly.
cues.en: Doing more and better regularly.
cues.zh: 定期去做，做得越多，做得更好。

cues.text: It's reps of action that drive confidence.
cues.en: It's reps of action that drive confidence.
cues.zh: 不斷重複行動才能帶出信心。

cues.text: And that action, and that confidence is what allows us to learn and grow.
cues.en: And that action, and that confidence is what allows us to learn and grow.
cues.zh: 那種行動力和信心 才會讓我們學習和成長。

cues.text: I'm someone who wants to continue to learn and grow.
cues.en: I'm someone who wants to continue to learn and grow.
cues.zh: 我是個想要持續學習和成長的人。

cues.text: No matter how old I get,
cues.en: No matter how old I get,
cues.zh: 無論我年紀多大、

cues.text: how many successes or challenges, how long I've been in a role or company,
cues.en: how many successes or challenges, how long I've been in a role or company,
cues.zh: 經歷過多少成功或挑戰、

cues.text: I want to get better.
cues.en: I want to get better.

cues.en: And you’re here, so I know you do, too.

cues.text: can help us cut through the challenges that are in our way to acting our way

cues.text: to confidence and growth.
cues.en: to confidence and growth.
cues.zh: 許多人認為，最好的行動 就是在艱難的時刻所做的事，

cues.text: when we show up in tough times, and that's true.
cues.en: when we show up in tough times, and that's true.
cues.zh: 的確，但在困境中採取大膽行動 幾乎可說是比較容易的，

cues.text: But it's almost easier to take bold action when things are hard.
cues.en: But it's almost easier to take bold action when things are hard.
cues.zh: 的確，但在困境中採取大膽行動 幾乎可說是比較容易的，

cues.text: The more special muscle is the ability to coach ourselves to be greater,

cues.zh: 更難能可貴的，是督促自己

cues.text: to do more, to be better, even when times are pretty good,
cues.en: to do more, to be better, even when times are pretty good,
cues.zh: 即使在順遂的時候， 也要做得更好、做得更多，

cues.text: and to recognize that complacency is a very real thing,

cues.en: So one of the tools in my toolbox to drive action and confidence and growth
cues.zh: 因此，我的工具箱中，用來推促 行動、信心，和成長的工具之一

cues.text: is the ability to cut through that complacency.
cues.en: is the ability to cut through that complacency.

cues.text: And I first learned this lesson from my mom.
cues.en: And I first learned this lesson from my mom.
cues.zh: 我最早是從我媽媽那裡 學到這個教訓。

cues.text: When I was nine years old,
cues.en: When I was nine years old,
cues.zh: 我九歲那年，媽媽走來對我說： 「夠了，我受夠了，我們離開吧。」

cues.text: my mom came to me and said, "That's it, I'm done. We're leaving."
cues.en: my mom came to me and said, "That's it, I'm done. We're leaving."
cues.zh: 我九歲那年，媽媽走來對我說： 「夠了，我受夠了，我們離開吧。」

cues.text: And what she meant was we were leaving my father.
cues.en: And what she meant was we were leaving my father.
cues.zh: 她的意思是我們要離開我爸爸。

cues.text: My father was and is a very good man.
cues.en: My father was and is a very good man.
cues.zh: 我父親曾是也仍然是個非常好的人。

cues.text: But at the time, he was an alcoholic and a terrible husband and father.
cues.en: But at the time, he was an alcoholic and a terrible husband and father.
cues.zh: 但在當時，他是個酒鬼， 也是個糟糕的丈夫和父親。

cues.text: So when my mom came to me at the age of nine,
cues.en: So when my mom came to me at the age of nine,
cues.zh: 因此我九歲那年， 我媽媽告訴我這件事時，

cues.text: I didn’t cry, and I didn’t get upset.
cues.en: I didn’t cry, and I didn’t get upset.
cues.zh: 我沒有哭，也沒有難過。

cues.text: I remember thinking, "What took you so long?
cues.en: I remember thinking, "What took you so long?
cues.zh: 我記得自己心想： 「你怎麼現在才想通？

cues.text: Finally, it's about time."
cues.en: Finally, it's about time."
cues.zh: 終於，也該是時候了。」

cues.text: So often there are people around us just waiting on us to take the action,
cues.en: So often there are people around us just waiting on us to take the action,
cues.zh: 常常，周圍的人都在等我們

cues.text: to do the thing, to do the right thing.
cues.en: to do the thing, to do the right thing.
cues.zh: 採取行動，去做那件事，對的事。

cues.text: And since then, I've been inspired
cues.en: And since then, I've been inspired
cues.zh: 從那時起，我就受到鼓舞，

cues.text: to have practices that drive action over and over.
cues.en: to have practices that drive action over and over.
cues.zh: 一次又一次養成實際行動的習慣。

cues.text: Little ones every day, or bigger ones, like what my mom did that day.
cues.en: Little ones every day, or bigger ones, like what my mom did that day.
cues.zh: 每天一些小行動，也會有 像我媽媽那天採取的那種大行動。

cues.text: We did leave my dad.
cues.en: We did leave my dad.
cues.zh: 我們確實離開了我爸爸。

cues.text: My mom fed us on a meager food budget, worked multiple jobs for many years,
cues.en: My mom fed us on a meager food budget, worked multiple jobs for many years,
cues.zh: 我媽媽用微薄的伙食費養活我們， 多年來身兼多份工作，

cues.text: and over the course of my young life, I got to see her day-to-day example.
cues.en: and over the course of my young life, I got to see her day-to-day example.
cues.zh: 在我成長過程中， 她就是我每天都看得到的榜樣。

cues.text: Someone without resources, without a playbook.
cues.en: Someone without resources, without a playbook.
cues.zh: 她沒有資源，沒有指引。

cues.text: She had no coach. She had no one to mentor her through this experience.
cues.en: She had no coach. She had no one to mentor her through this experience.
cues.zh: 她沒有教練，沒有人 指導她如何度過那段經歷。

cues.text: She just acted her way to growth and improvement over time.
cues.en: She just acted her way to growth and improvement over time.
cues.zh: 她就只是靠行動走出她的路， 隨時間逐漸成長並變得更好。

cues.text: As a result of this childhood, I started working at a very young age.
cues.en: As a result of this childhood, I started working at a very young age.

cues.en: At 15, I worked in malls.

cues.en: At 17, I was a restaurant hostess, at 18, a waitress.
cues.zh: 十七歲去做餐廳接待員， 十八歲去做服務生。

cues.en: At 19, I began my leadership journey, opening franchises around the world.

cues.en: By the age of 26, I was an executive in a very large company.

cues.en: The mentoring, the things that could help stretch me beyond my day-to-day job.
cues.zh: 那種能推我走出日常工作、 讓我進一步成長的指導。

cues.text: So I started developing some self-coaching practices.
cues.en: So I started developing some self-coaching practices.
cues.zh: 所以，我開始開發 一些自我指導的做法。

cues.text: to help motivate you to take action.
cues.en: to help motivate you to take action.

cues.en: and there was something about thinking of someone I admired

cues.en: that brought this element of additional capabilities and excellence.

cues.en: It also made me feel a little accountable to act on whatever came to mind.

cues.text: And these practices evolved into today what is the “hot shot rule.”
cues.en: And these practices evolved into today what is the “hot shot rule.”
cues.zh: 而這些做法漸漸演化成 現今的「大人物法則」。

cues.text: The hot shot rule is simply this.
cues.en: The hot shot rule is simply this.
cues.zh: 大人物法則就是：

cues.text: It is the act of regularly thinking about my role, everything I have,
cues.en: It is the act of regularly thinking about my role, everything I have,
cues.zh: 經常思考我的角色、 我擁有的一切、

cues.text: the challenges, the opportunities,
cues.en: the challenges, the opportunities,

cues.text: envisioning someone I admire in my role,
cues.en: envisioning someone I admire in my role,
cues.zh: 想像我敬佩的人坐在我的位置上，

cues.text: asking myself what's one thing that person I admire would do differently
cues.en: asking myself what's one thing that person I admire would do differently
cues.zh: 問自己，我敬佩的那個人 會有什麼不同的做法，

cues.text: to make that situation better,
cues.en: to make that situation better,

cues.text: and then -- that's not the last step -- telling those involved
cues.en: and then -- that's not the last step -- telling those involved
cues.zh: 然後——這不是最後一步——

cues.text: once things get put in motion.
cues.en: once things get put in motion.
cues.zh: 比如，我會說：「嘿，

cues.en: I say something like,
cues.zh: 比如，我會說：「嘿，

cues.text: "Hey, I could have or should have done this thing, but I didn't.
cues.en: "Hey, I could have or should have done this thing, but I didn't.
cues.zh: 我本來可以／應該這麼做， 卻沒有做，現在我們在做了……」

cues.text: And now we are..."
cues.en: And now we are..."
cues.zh: 咱們來練習看看。

cues.text: And so let's practice it.
cues.en: And so let's practice it.

cues.en: I think of how I can be a better daughter, and I envision someone I admire.

cues.text: But often, and we're here to talk about work,

cues.en: So I think about my role as CEO of AG1.

cues.text: I have this incredible opportunity to be the leader
cues.en: I have this incredible opportunity to be the leader
cues.zh: 我有這個非常棒的機會 可以當領導者，

cues.en: of a phenomenal, foundational nutrition company

cues.en: with millions of customers who rely on us to empower their health journeys,
cues.zh: 有數百萬名客戶仰賴我們 來支援他們維護改善健康，

cues.text: and so many team members who rely on me to be my best.

cues.text: Not comfortable because we've had multiple years of success,

cues.text: but always starting with that day one energy.
cues.en: but always starting with that day one energy.

cues.en: Then I envision someone I admire.
cues.zh: 接著我會想像一個我敬佩的人，

cues.zh: 想到某位剛失去父母或摯愛的人時，

cues.text: and envisioning them in my role.
cues.en: and envisioning them in my role.
cues.zh: 我想像他們扮演我的角色。

cues.text: And it’s led to me just picking up the phone

cues.text: and calling my mom, and saying, “I love you, and how are you?”
cues.en: and calling my mom, and saying, “I love you, and how are you?”
cues.zh: 說：「我愛你，你好嗎？」

cues.text: It's led to me saying "thank you" to my husband for being a great partner.
cues.en: It's led to me saying "thank you" to my husband for being a great partner.
cues.zh: 這讓我對我丈夫說「謝謝」， 因為他是很棒的伴侶。

cues.text: It's also led to me stopping initiatives in the company
cues.en: It's also led to me stopping initiatives in the company
cues.zh: 這也讓我停止公司的一些計畫，

cues.text: that I was allowing to perpetuate
cues.en: that I was allowing to perpetuate
cues.zh: 因為我之前容許它們延續， 只是出於不想跨出舒適圈，

cues.text: because things were just comfortable,
cues.en: because things were just comfortable,
cues.zh: 實際上它們早已無益於業務。

cues.text: but they were no longer serving the business.
cues.en: but they were no longer serving the business.
cues.zh: 實際上它們早已無益於業務。

cues.text: So that’s what the hot shot rule is.
cues.en: So that’s what the hot shot rule is.
cues.zh: 這就是大人物法則。

cues.text: And you can use it as a technique in a time of need anytime.
cues.en: And you can use it as a technique in a time of need anytime.
cues.zh: 你可以在需要時，隨時使用。

cues.text: But its power lies in it being a regular, proactive practice.
cues.en: But its power lies in it being a regular, proactive practice.
cues.zh: 但它的力量在於 成為一種固定、主動的習慣。

cues.text: It used to be quarterly and then monthly, but now I practice it weekly.
cues.en: It used to be quarterly and then monthly, but now I practice it weekly.
cues.zh: 我一開始是每季一次，後來變成 每月一次，現在是每週一次。

cues.text: Every Sunday at 1pm,
cues.en: Every Sunday at 1pm,
cues.zh: 以前每個星期日下午一點，

cues.text: when my kids, now five and seven, used to have naps --
cues.en: when my kids, now five and seven, used to have naps --
cues.zh: 我的孩子都會午睡， 他們現在五歲和七歲了，

cues.text: RIP naps --
cues.en: RIP naps --
cues.zh: 午睡已成過去式。

cues.text: (Laughter)
cues.en: (Laughter)
cues.zh: （笑聲）

cues.text: I take just a minute for myself.
cues.en: I take just a minute for myself.
cues.zh: 那時我會留一分鐘給我自己。

cues.text: I envision my role, I envision someone I admire.
cues.en: I envision my role, I envision someone I admire.
cues.zh: 我想像我的角色， 我想像一位我敬佩的人。

cues.text: I ask myself, what's one thing they would do differently in my role.
cues.en: I ask myself, what's one thing they would do differently in my role.
cues.zh: 我問自己，他們在我的角色中 會有什麼不同的做法。

cues.text: The answer comes to mind.
cues.en: The answer comes to mind.
cues.zh: 答案在腦中浮現。

cues.text: I send the email, I schedule the flight,
cues.en: I send the email, I schedule the flight,
cues.zh: 我就寄電子郵件，安排航班， 讓事情開始推動，再告知我的團隊。

cues.text: I put it in motion,
cues.en: I put it in motion,
cues.zh: 我就寄電子郵件，安排航班， 讓事情開始推動，再告知我的團隊。

cues.text: and then once it's in motion, I tell my team.
cues.en: and then once it's in motion, I tell my team.
cues.zh: 每週這麼做，持續一年以上， 就可能會有以下結果：

cues.text: And over a year of practicing this weekly, a few things will happen.
cues.en: And over a year of practicing this weekly, a few things will happen.
cues.zh: 每週這麼做，持續一年以上， 就可能會有以下結果：

cues.text: One, there are 52 things you've done that you otherwise might not have done
cues.en: One, there are 52 things you've done that you otherwise might not have done
cues.zh: 第一，你做了 52 件本來可能 不會做或不會這麼快去做的事。

cues.text: or done as quickly.
cues.en: or done as quickly.
cues.zh: 讓大家知道你可以展現脆弱 且會積極採取行動。

cues.text: It builds a reputation of vulnerability and bias for action.
cues.en: It builds a reputation of vulnerability and bias for action.
cues.zh: 讓大家知道你可以展現脆弱 且會積極採取行動。

cues.text: My team brings things to me now
cues.en: My team brings things to me now
cues.zh: 我的團隊現在會主動來找我討論， 因為他們知道我常會自我檢討。

cues.text: because they know I'm constantly calling myself out.
cues.en: because they know I'm constantly calling myself out.
cues.zh: 我的團隊現在會主動來找我討論， 因為他們知道我常會自我檢討。

cues.text: This practice has changed my life,
cues.en: This practice has changed my life,
cues.zh: 這個做法改變了我的人生，

cues.text: and I believe it will change yours if you apply it.
cues.en: and I believe it will change yours if you apply it.
cues.zh: 我相信如果你這麼做， 它也會改變你的人生。

cues.text: The idea of having a practice of reflection, intention and action
cues.en: The idea of having a practice of reflection, intention and action
cues.zh: 擁有一種結合反思、意圖與行動的習慣，

cues.text: to drive growth, to show up and do something
cues.en: to drive growth, to show up and do something
cues.zh: 來推動成長，挺身而出， 去做原本不會做的事，

cues.text: we otherwise wouldn’t have,
cues.en: we otherwise wouldn’t have,
cues.zh: 打破自滿或過去的模式，

cues.text: to break through complacency or past patterns is a superpower.
cues.en: to break through complacency or past patterns is a superpower.
cues.zh: 打破自滿或過去的模式，

cues.text: So be like my mom.
cues.en: So be like my mom.
cues.zh: 所以，要像我媽媽一樣，

cues.text: Don't let patterns of the past get in the way
cues.en: Don't let patterns of the past get in the way
cues.zh: 別讓過去的模式阻礙你 明天採取不同的行動。

cues.text: of doing something different tomorrow.
cues.en: of doing something different tomorrow.
cues.zh: 提出有助於促進行動的問題。

cues.text: Ask questions that help motivate action.
cues.en: Ask questions that help motivate action.
cues.zh: 提出有助於促進行動的問題。

cues.text: And act your way into growth and confidence.
cues.en: And act your way into growth and confidence.
cues.zh: 採取行動，朝向成長及信心邁進。

cues.text: Thank you.
cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 謝謝。

cues.text: (Applause)
cues.en: (Applause)
cues.zh: （掌聲）
